name: q_graph_propagation_v1
description: Queue-stage test for graph propagation reranking (S05). Tests that graph distance features are computed and used in scoring.

expected_graph_features.notes: S05: Graph propagation should load items and bonds, compute distances, and influence scoring.

notes: This test validates S05 graph propagation. In a real scenario with deeper graph structure, closer nodes should rank higher. For the golden flow (minimal graph), this verifies the infrastructure works.
